title: CS Convergence Threads — mini dossier
summary: Compact synthesis of 18 customer threads (enterprise + PLG) surfaced between Feb 3–Mar 10 2025. Focus: latency tail, embedding cost surprises, private deploy onboarding roughness. Purpose: give eng/product quick, low-friction next-step options (1–3 sprints) + one experimental probe.
highlights: Recurring ask: predictable 99th percentile latency for short-chat flows (<= 200 tokens) — customers report spikes when autoscale triggers
Embedding customers surprised by per-request overhead (cold-start + batching delays) that dominates cost for low-volume workflows
Private deploy onboarding friction: network / KMS handoff patterns differ across clouds; docs + checklist gaps cause multi-day provisioning delays
Several customers (3 large accounts) asked for an infer-cost estimator (per-route) that factors batching profile and cache hit rates
customer_vignettes: FinTech client (S1): 'Our chat bot is fine at median latency, but occasional 800–1200ms spikes kill UX. We're using small sequences — we expect <200ms tail. We don't know what's causing autoscale thrash.'
Marketplace startup (PLG): 'Embedding cost is unpredictable — small daily batches of 50 items charge like bulk jobs because latency waits for batching window.'
Healthcare pilot (Private): 'KMS integration worked, but audit logs are scattered between control-plane and hosts — compliance team wants unified audit stream.'
request_buckets: Latency SLOs & tail analysis: tooling to show per-route 50/95/99 tail with autoscale events overlaid
Embedding billing clarity: per-batch cost breakdown + recommended batching window per traffic profile
Private onboarding checklist: single-page runbook that enumerates cloud-specific steps (VPC peering, KMS roles, firewall rules) and sample terraform snippets
Route-level cost estimator: simulate token mix + cache hit assumptions and output expected per-call unit cost
quick_fixes: Add an autoscale-event overlay to existing latency chart (console) — low dev effort, high signal for CS + customers
Expose batching window metric in metrics endpoint (prometheus label) so customers can tune client-side windows
Draft a ‘Private onboarding one-pager’ and store in product playbooks; include KMS role JSON and minimal firewall checklist
Create a FAQ entry describing what drives embedding cold-start cost and recommended client-side strategies (micro-batching vs. warming)
proposed_experiments: Probe: 2-week pilot with 2 PLG customers to trial dynamic batching suggestion (server-proposed window) and measure median vs tail cost/latency — ticket ENG-3456
Canary: enable lightweight KV-cache prewarm for short-chat flows for 5% of hosted traffic and measure 99th percentile impact (hypothesis: tail reduces by 30–50%)
Docs experiment: embed a small interactive cost estimator in the console (client-side only) and monitor usage -> convert to backend if demand high
impact_estimates: Autoscale-overlay chart: effort 2–3 dev days + 1 product review; expected reduction in triage time for CS by 60%
Batching-window metric: 1 dev day + ops review; enables two customer-workarounds immediately
Private onboarding one-pager: 1 writer day + 1 infra SME review; expected to cut onboarding time by 30–50% for first-run customers
Dynamic batching pilot: engineering effort 3–4 sprints (experiment infra + telemetry); if successful could reduce token cost for low-volume embedding customers by ~20%
acceptance_criteria: Autoscale chart: latency chart displays autoscale events with hover showing event id + time; CS can link to related request traces
Batching metric: metric emitted at route level, visible in console and prometheus; sample query included in docs
Onboarding one-pager: contains exact KMS role JSON for AWS/GCP, network CIDR checklist, and two terraform snippet examples; reviewed by infra and legal
Cost estimator (MVP): given token mix and batch size assumption, returns per-call cost estimate within +/- 20% of actual for test harness
unresolved_questions: How often do autoscale events correlate with model fallbacks vs. real capacity churn? Need trace correlations (SRE input)
Do customers prefer client-side microbatching or server-suggested windows? (UX research ask)
Audit logs unification for Private: do we deliver a single consolidated stream or a helper that stitches control-plane + node logs? Compliance prefers single stream but infra cost could be high
action_items: Asha: schedule 30m sync with SRE (Marcus) to review autoscale-event semantics by Apr 4
Priya: spin up onboarding one-pager draft and post to /product/playbooks by Apr 8
Luca: open ENG ticket for autoscale chart overlay (ENG-3599) and assign to console eng lead
CS team: identify 2 PLG customers willing to join dynamic batching pilot (deadline Apr 11)
notes:
Quick plaintext notes / scratchpad below:
- Observed pattern: low-volume embedding jobs charged as if bulk: likely because server waits for batching window when no existing batch active. Quick win: expose batching window and let clients choose immediate dispatch with price warning.
- Several customers refer to 'taily spikes' only during business hours in a single region — could be shared infra interference. SRE to confirm.
- KMS: customers want an auditable mapping file — which key used for which dataset. Add to onboarding doc.
- UX idea: route-level toggles to prefer cost over latency for embeddings (PLG user toggle). Low priority but high delight.
- Keep this doc short; follow-up will be a combined PRD for the highest-value experiment if pilots show signal.
